exposure: Abdominal scar tissue characteristics (surface appearance, pigmentation)
Duration of corset use after prior CS
cohort: The study recruited 800 women in their third trimester of pregnancy who were admitted for repeat cesarean sections.
finding: The number of previous cesarean sections was significantly associated with the severity of intra-abdominal adhesions, while scar tissue characteristics, striae gravidarum density, and history of corset use were not predictive.
mod_finding: The number of previous cesarean sections was significantly associated with intra-abdominal adhesion scores, with each additional previous CS increasing the odds of developing dense adhesions nearly threefold.
cross-section timing: At the time of repeat cesarean section, with data collected in the third trimester of pregnancy and intraoperatively.
